name: 48161 · Monroe, MI
findings: ZIP 48161 (Monroe) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 47 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48161 (Monroe) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48161 (Monroe) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
